A '''golden shovel''' is the [[Golden equipment|golden]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], crafted from [[Gold Ingot|gold ingots]]. It mines at speed 15 and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/golden_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines shovel blocks at speed 15 (vanilla: 12).

=== Combat ===

It deals 2.5 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Fortune]] I

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Golden equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Gold Ingot|gold ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Gold Ingot|gold ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/gold_ingot_from_blasting_gold_materials.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows mining speed 12 (real value 15).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/golden_shovel.json}}</ref>
